title: Connected explicit-message framing
purpose: Cover the connected encapsulation and CPF path with distinct Connected Address and Connected Data items after session registration.
expected_behavior: After runtime substitution of the registered session handle, the server parses the connected CPF structure and may return a CIP response, a connection-state error, or another ordinary protocol error because a prior ForwardOpen is not included.
constraints_preserved: CPF contains exactly two items in documented connected order
Connected Address Item type is 0x0100 with a four-byte connection identifier
Connected Data Item type is 0x00B1 with a ten-byte payload containing a two-byte sequence value and an eight-byte CIP request
The second frame uses a runtime-substituted session handle
issue_safety_notes: Exercises connected data length and CPF parsing without claiming a ForwardOpen-created connection. The connection identifier and CIP layout are conservative inferred values, not historical issue bytes.
